cases.refreshed: Drop in on Tuesday afternoons at 4:30 p.m. for a new STEaM adventure every week. Active engagement with STEaM promotes academic success. Topic list is subject to change; please check back or call the branch for up-to-date details. Suggested ages vary; please refer to individual program descriptions. Free, with limited capacity. Tickets will be distributed starting 60 minutes before the program. Aug 18 - The Science of Soap: Floating Drawing & Pepper Experiment Participants will learn about the properties of soap, how it cleans and why that's important by creating their own floating drawings and playing with adhesion and repulsion properties of pepper and soap. Aug 25 - Logic Games Work individually or in teams to solve a variety of logic puzzles. Please note that the Mental Math: Multiplication program has been Rescheduled for Sept 22 and the other math topics have moved accordingly Sept 1 - Marble Run Fun Harness the force of gravity as you create your own marble run. Sept 8 - Lego Engineering Challenge (please note topic change) In this workshop, children will be encouraged to build and solve problems. Children will learn to brainstorm and build with Lego bricks, and then to redesign and build as they face challenges. For children ages 5 and up. Volcanoes (will be rescheduled at a later time) Learn about the different types of volcanoes and create your own eruption with common household ingredients. Sept 15 - Spike Robotics Code Quest Learn to code a pre-built Lego Spike robot to move around and collect components using a block-based coding language similar to Scratch. Sept 22 - Mental Math: Multiplication Children have the opportunity to learn and practice multiplication skills with a focus on understanding how multiplication works and is related to addition. Oct 6 - Wind Turbine Engineering In this hands-on workshop, participants will build their own working wind turbines using everyday household items. Through fun, interactive experiments, they will test different designs and observe the impact of tweakable variables on performance. Lesson by Nurturing Young Mindz Foundation. Oct 13 - Paper Rockets Learn what makes rockets fly high and far! Then join us in making a rocket of your own that can fly the furthest! Participants will learn about propulsion, then create their own rockets. Oct 20 - Properties of Water (Science from Scientists) Participants will explore cohesion, adhesion and surface tension through a series of simple activities that encourage them to investigate and make observations about the unique properties of water. Free, with limited capacity. Tickets will be distributed starting 60 minutes before the program. Children younger than age 9 must be accompanied by an adult caregiver during this program. Oct 27 - TBA Nov 3 - Learn About Aerodynamics Through Paper Planes In this high-flying workshop, participants will build different types of paper planes and learn concepts of aerodynamics and impact of plane design through fun and interactive experiments. Lesson by Nurturing Young Mindz Foundation. Nov 10 - Ozobot Maze Runner Teach your Ozobot to navigate a maze using simple color codes. Nov 17 - Logic Games Work individually or in teams to solve a variety of logic puzzles. Nov 24 - TBA Dec 1 - Let's Build Parachutes In this workshop, participants will build parachutes of different shapes, sizes and materials, and observe the impact of their design. They will participate in fun parachute drops with different loads while learning the science behind parachute design. Lesson by Nurturing Young Mindz Foundation. Dec 8 - Lego Engineering Challenge In this workshop, children will be encouraged to build and solve problems. Children will learn to brainstorm and build with Lego bricks, and then to redesign and build as they face challenges. For children ages 5 and up.

events.title: Social Workers in the Library Drop-In Hours

cases.refreshed: Advice | Information | Referral Social Workers in the Library offers free social service information and referrals*. Our staff can meet with you, approach your needs without judgement, and help you find where to go for shelter, food, showers, mental health services, legal help, and more. Free. No registration required. *Disclaimer: SJPL's Social Work in the Library does not establish a social worker-client relationship. SJPL does not offer case management or extensive follow-up services. We will try our best to get you connected to any resource we know of that could suit your needs. Tư Vấn / Thông Tin / Giới Thiệu Nhân Viên Xã Hội trong Thư Viện cung cấp miễn phí thông tin về những dịch vụ xã hội và giới thiệu. Nhân viên của chúng tôi có thể gặp gỡ bạn, tiếp cận với nhu cầu của bạn mà không đánh giá, và giúp bạn tìm những nơi để đến trú ẩn, thực phẩm, tắm rửa, những dịch vụ sức khoẻ tâm thần, trợ giúp pháp lý, và nhiều hơn nữa. Miễn phí. Không bắt buộc phải đăng ký. Từ chối trách nhiệm: Nhân Viên Xã Hội của SJPL trong Thư Viện không thiết lập mối quan hệ giữa một nhân viên xã hội và khách hàng. SJPL không cung cấp quản lý các trường hợp hoặc dịch vụ theo dõi mở rộng. Chúng tôi sẽ cố gắng hết sức để kết nối bạn với bất kỳ nguồn nào chúng tôi biết có thể phù hợp với nhu cầu của bạn. Asesoramiento | Información | Referencia Este programa ofrece información y referencias de servicios sociales gratuitos. Nuestro personal puede reunirse con usted, abordar sus necesidades sin juicio y ayudarle a encontrar dónde ir para obtener refugio, comida, duchas, servicios de salud mental, ayuda legal y más. Gratis. No Registracion Requerida *Aviso: El Trabajo Social en la Biblioteca de SJPL no establece una relación de Trabajador Social-Cliente. SJPL no ofrece gestión de casos ni servicios de seguimiento extensos. Haremos todo lo posible por conectarte con cualquier recurso que conozcamos y que puede satisfacer tus necesidades.

cases.refreshed: Math Buddies provides students in grades K-3 with an opportunity to improve their math skills by working one-on-one with a volunteer. At Math Buddies, volunteers sit with participating children for an individual, 15-20 minute tutoring session. Volunteers may help participants complete math homework assignments or math worksheet(s) provided by Math Buddies volunteers. Math Buddies creates a positive learning experience for students who may be struggling with math or lack confidence as math students. Free. Pre-registration not required. However, tutoring sessions are available on a first-come, first-served basis, and the availability of sessions may be limited depending on the number of volunteers and/or participating children.

events.title: Medicare: Enrollment, 2027 Updates and Plan Review Tips

cases.refreshed: The Medicare Annual Enrollment Period (AEP) runs from October 15 through December 7 each year. During this time, Medicare beneficiaries can review and make changes to their Medicare health and prescription drug coverage for the coming year. Join HICAP (Health Insurance Counseling & Advocacy Program) for a free educational presentation covering Medicare updates taking effect in 2027, Medicare Advantage and Part D plan review strategies, and important factors to consider when evaluating your coverage options. Learn how to compare plan costs, provider networks, prescription drug coverage, and other benefits to determine whether your current plan continues to meet your needs. Following the presentation, HICAP counselors will be available for free one-on-one counseling sessions to answer Medicare questions and help attendees review their coverage options. HICAP counselors are unbiased and are not affiliated with any insurance company. The one-on-one sessions will be on a first-come, first-served basis. HICAP is a program of Sourcewise providing free Medicare counseling to Santa Clara County residents. Who Should Attend? Current Medicare beneficiaries reviewing their coverage for 2027; Individuals approaching Medicare eligibility; Family members and caregivers assisting a Medicare beneficiary. What You Will Learn: Medicare updates taking effect in 2027; How the Annual Enrollment Period works; Medicare Advantage and Part D plan review tips; How to compare costs, coverage, and provider networks; Prescription drug coverage considerations; When it may make sense to change plans; Resources and assistance available through HICAP. What to Bring: A complete list of your prescription medications, including dosage and quantity, for accurate plan comparisons. Your Medicare card (optional, but helpful). HICAP counselors will have laptops available for Medicare plan reviews, but attendees are welcome to bring their own laptop or tablet. Time Required The time needed to complete a plan comparison varies depending on the number of prescriptions and coverage options being reviewed. Most plan reviews take approximately 30–60 minutes. This program is intended for Santa Clara County residents. Please register if you would like to receive a reminder about the presentation. For accessibility accommodations (ex. ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@sccl.org. About Sourcewise Since 1973, Sourcewise has provided services and support to seniors in Santa Clara County. Sourcewise aims to inform, educate, and prepare all adults within Santa Clara County to better navigate their health and life options.

cases.refreshed: Do you enjoy working with yarn, knitting or crochet? Want to see what others are working on, refine your skills, or talk about all things yarn, knitting and crochet? All hand needle crafts welcome. No training or supplies are provided, but if you need advice there are many experienced knitters who are happy to lend a hand. Grab your project and join us weekly in the Willow Glen Library Community Room. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Come join us for a set of STEM activities presented by Lynbrook High School's Women in STEM Club! Each month you'll explore a new set of topics as you learn about different fields of science and how they relate to the world. All materials will be provided. The experiments and demonstrations in this program are intended for an elementary-school age audience. Parental supervision is required. Free. No registration required.
